label: Horizontal
description: Horizontal separator for content sections.. Best for a heading with a muted subtitle, set off from a muted paragraph of body copy by one full width rule.

label: Vertical
description: Vertical separator for inline elements.. Best for a single line of 3 one word labels, Blog, Docs and Source, split by 2 rules as tall as the row.

label: Grouped Menu Items
description: Vertical separator groups related menu items.. Best for side by side entries, each a medium weight title over a muted caption, split by short rules centered in the row.

label: List Rows
description: Horizontal separator between items in a list.. Best for a stack of 3 label and value rows with a rule between every row, labels on the left and muted values on the right.

label: Centered Label
description: Separator with centered text label. Best for a lone rule with a small muted caption, or continue with, sitting on a background patch at its middle.

label: Order Summary
description: Order summary with separators. Best for a price breakdown of subtotal, discount and tax, ruled off from its heading above and from a medium weight total below.
